game_concept: A survival strategy set in Mystic Forest – Woodcutter Clearing, a woodcutter's clearing: the forest ranger must handle cursed treants while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Loop Choreography: Repeat dance moves in loops to sync a routine with the beat.
theme: Mystic Forest – Woodcutter Clearing: a woodcutter's clearing
core_gameplay_loop: In Woodcutter Clearing, repeat each round: Repeat dance moves in loops to sync a routine with the beat. Each round, cursed treants strike the fairy lantern, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the sync value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the fairy lantern from cursed treants in Woodcutter Clearing: keep the sync meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 24-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: sync drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 24-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 1 (intro tier): Loop Choreography
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
